query: Putting Out Fires "It's for putting fires out," Kael says again, and nods across the duel hall to where Lyra is practising, very loudly, with a very large flame. He waits to see whether you'll take the hint. Put out Lyra's flame Your frost meets her flame and they cancel with a hiss and a cloud of steam. Lyra's face, when it clears, is magnificent. Kael makes a sound you think is a laugh. Practise on the braziers instead You frost the braziers one by one. It's useful, and dull, and Kael stays with you for all of it without saying anything. You suspect that was the point.
